scope: Local final parser execution over every available archived case. Main flow only; Plan B excluded. No live deployment or live acceptance is inferred from this report.
parserCommitNote: The run may precede the source commit; the exact checked source is identified by parserSha256.

policyDecision.rule: Pure tax refunds and supplier refunds of duplicate payments are other and must remain untouched. A pure question asking whether payment was received or an invoice paid, without an independent payment confirmation, is likewise other. Genuine customer payments and uncertain actual advices remain protected.
